about_short_description.short_description: Stable is a risk management platform that helps businesses manage exposure to volatile commodity prices.

product.name: Commodity Risk Management Platform
product.description: A platform that uses AI to analyze and manage exposure to volatile commodity prices by matching commodities to third-party benchmarks and generating scenario analyses.

product.name: Price Risk Protection Contracts
product.description: Contracts that protect businesses from commodity price volatility by paying out if benchmark prices exceed predefined protection levels, with premiums as the only cost.

product.name: AI-Powered Risk Analysis Tools
product.description: Free AI-driven tools that provide weekly market insights and enable users to build and share risk management plans for tracked commodity markets.
